message.description: Using the spread operator on a string can mishandle special characters, because it produces Unicode code points, which will break complex characters (like emojis) into multiple parts.
message.help: Consider using `Intl.Segmenter` for locale-aware string decomposition. Otherwise, if you don't need to preserve emojis or other non-ASCII characters, disable this lint rule on this line or configure the 'allow' rule option.
